newsitem.title: USA: Anthem to sell Acordia insurance brokerage.
newsitem.headline: Anthem to sell Acordia insurance brokerage.

text.p: Anthem Inc said Monday it has signed a definitive agreement to sell its Acordia Inc insurance brokerage operations to a management group co-sponsored by Knightsbridge Capital LLC and Wand Partners Inc.

The purchase agreement calls for the equity group to pay $320 million, including the assumption of about $40 million of debt and a $10 million contingent payment based upon future operating earnings. The transaction is expected to close at the end of August, the company said.

Last month, Anthem, Acordia's majority shareholder, purchased the minority interest in Acordia from that company's shareholders and then began integrating Acordia's Anthem-related health operations in Indiana, Kentucky and Ohio into its Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield operations.

At the same time, Anthem conducted discussions with third parties regarding the sale of Acordia's nationwide insurance brokerage operations, which had $305 million in annual revenue in 1996. As part of the sale, certain claims administration operations which had revenue of about $40 million were retained by Anthem, the company said.
